done_when: Each worker pull request summary carries three lines written before coding (the need, the simplest option, the existing code reused), a layer appears only at the edge to an outside service, and the review checks the change against those three lines.

known.title: Restrict approach lookup to the current worker's commits

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - a worker starts a stacked task or follow-up fix from an unmerged parent that already recorded its approach.
The reversed base-to-head history includes the parent's planning commit, so this function returns the parent's three lines and ignores the current worker's later planning commit. Stacked tasks inherit their parent's commits (`src/forge/task.py:402-408`), as do follow-up fixes (`src/forge/task.py:553-559`). Consequently, the child pull request summary and review receive another change's approach. Limit lookup to the current item's own history in the summary, review and fingerprint callers.
findings.title: Restrict approach lookup to the current worker's commits

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 1
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - close generates the review instructions for a worker change.
The proof list names this test as protection for checking pre-code git history, but its assertions only check copying, comparison wording and the layer rule. Removing the instruction to verify an empty commit before code changes would leave the test passing. Moreover, `env.start_fix()` already commits `app.py` before the planning commit (`tests/test_close.py:217-233`), so the fixture does not demonstrate the promised ordering. Create the planning commit before the first product change and assert that the delivered review instructions require checking that history.
findings.title: Gate: test_2_close_copies_the_original_three_lines_to_summary_and_review

stop.reason: The owner chose one more round: read the newest planning lines on this branch from its head, and fix the test name or its check

why: Workers add code and layers before they think through the simplest way, and the rules say where not to add layers but not where a layer belongs, so the review has nothing written before coding to check the change against.
